reviews.text: They take good care of your dog, they took time and care on his first visit. The daily pictures are just too cute.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The Best Daycare for Rollo! 🐾❤️

I honestly cannot say enough wonderful things about ATD CLIBHOUSE ! From the moment we found them, I knew he was in good hands. The team is incredibly loving, caring, patient, and attentive, and it is so clear that they genuinely love what they do. They treat every dog with so much affection and make sure each one feels safe, comfortable, and loved.

One of the things I appreciate most is how organized and professional they are. Communication is great, everything is well planned, and you can really tell how much thought and effort goes into making sure the dogs have the best possible experience. They create such a positive, fun, and welcoming environment where the dogs can socialize, play, learn, and be themselves.

As a dog mom, leaving your puppy in someone else’s care can be nerve-racking, but knowing Rollo is surrounded by people who genuinely care about his well-being gives me so much peace of mind. I love knowing that he is not only being looked after but is also receiving so much love, attention, and enrichment throughout the day. You can truly feel the passion and dedication behind everything they do!

I am so grateful to have found a daycare where Rollo is treated like family. It is such a special feeling knowing that he gets excited to go somewhere he feels happy, safe, and loved. ❤️🐶

If you are looking for a daycare that is loving, trustworthy, organized, professional, and truly dedicated to the happiness and well-being of your fur baby, I could not recommend ATD CLUBHOUSE  enough! They go above and beyond, and it shows in everything they do. Thank you for taking such amazing care of our little Rollo! We appreciate you more than you know! 🐾💕

I absolutely love All the Dogs! Both of my puppies go there, and I honestly couldn’t ask for a better place for them. The staff is absolutely amazing, so caring, friendly, and genuinely passionate about dogs. They treat every dog like their own, and it gives me so much peace of mind knowing my babies are in such good hands.

The facility is always clean, welcoming, and well organized. My puppies have the best time there, and I love knowing they’re getting to socialize, play, and receive so much love and attention throughout the day.

I truly can’t recommend All the Dog enough! They are hands down the best, and I’m so grateful to have found a place I can trust with my babies. ❤️🐾

ATD has been a great discovery. My little morkie Bear is by nature very anxious and would not let many people around him.

Nancy does such an amazing job with his grooming and making him feel comfortable.

The daycare staff is equally amazing. My mind is put at ease knowing Bear is well taken care of!

Finally, Cassidy and Catherine are just amazing! They are both kind, caring and helpful!

Every visit is something to look forward to and we are so happy to have ATD be apart of Bear’s moments!

You will definitely not regret giving them a try!

I’ve had my dog consistently come to ATD clubhouse for over a month now. He can be hesitant at first and can lack social skills with other dogs, but he absolutely loves going to daycare there. All the staff are so friendly and kind to him, and he pulls me non stop to enter and see all his friends every morning we walk through the door. I truly cannot recommend them enough - I feel so comfortable leaving my dog there all day and know he’s getting top tier care from every staff member. The daily updates with photos and videos of all the dogs is another great perk that shows how much fun the dogs have together.

My dog needed a break from touristing all over the city with me,  and ATD worked with me to make it a smooth as possible, even offering pickup and drop off if I wanted.  They were all patient,  kind,  and i could tell they really love their mission there at ATD.  I would love to send my dog there again.

I had a wonderful experience at the ATD Clubhouse! First, the interior is beautiful and clean. Second, the staff is super welcoming, incredibly friendly, and very knowledgeable. I came looking for my puppy to have his first grooming session and puppy socialization, and couldn’t have asked for better service. He came out looking amazing and so happy! You can tell they take amazing care of each and every pet that comes in. I felt such at ease leaving him in their hands. They gave me plenty of helpful information on how to ensure that my puppy keeps a positive experience with his grooming. We can’t wait to come back for many more sessions. ☺️
Nancy did a great job on Guizmo, like always! Highly recommended!

We were thrilled to find ADT Clubhouse for our young dog during our monthlong stay in Montreal. They provided transportation, daycare and daily photos and videos so we could see her interacting with other dogs and staff. The owners and staff are warm
and wonderful and it is clear they love what they do. Our dog was very happy there.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our community at ATD Clubhouse (Pour Tous Les Chiens). 🐾. …

Atd clubhouse has been so kind and caring for our small dog. We have been taking our dog there every week and he gets excited every morning he gets to go. Their pet boarding program is amazing; they helped us match with a family willing to take him in. Location is great, right by the metro.
Wonderful place, our pup had such an amazing time and got her first groom. We’re super excited to get her setup for her weekly visits to ATD clubhouse
I love this place! I've been bringing my two dogs here for over a year after trying several different places on Montreal Island! All the staff are attentive, and Nancy is the best! 😍😍😍

Being so reassured to take my two little babies to them and knowing they'll take such good care of them is so comforting. You do a truly wonderful job every time; we're very grateful because we know they're not always easy to work with either 🙈 I highly recommend their services! …
Exceptional service 💚 …

I cannot say enough wonderful things about ATD Clubhouse. From the moment Boudica started attending, it was clear that she was in a caring, safe, and professional environment where dogs are truly treated like family. The team is warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in making sure every dog has a positive experience.

Boudica always comes home happy, relaxed, and clearly fulfilled after a day at ATD Clubhouse. I appreciate the peace of mind that comes from knowing she is not only well cared for, but also enjoying her time with people who understand dogs and take pride in what they do.

The facility feels welcoming, organized, and thoughtfully run, and the staff’s kindness and professionalism really stand out. It is obvious that ATD Clubhouse creates an environment where dogs can feel comfortable, engaged, and loved.

I would wholeheartedly recommend ATD Clubhouse to anyone looking for a trustworthy and exceptional dog daycare. They have been fantastic with Boudica, and I am genuinely grateful to have found such a wonderful place for her.

Omg I couldn’t recommend ATD Clubhouse enough!! They will treat your baby like it’s their own. Whether you need daycare or boarding, you can leave your furry child in their very capable hands and have peace of mind. I feel so lucky to have found this place 😭💕 I recently had a medical emergency and the whole team rallied to take care of my Bibi until I was discharged from the hospital. I couldn’t have wished for a better outcome. This place is truly special and worth every penny. If you love your dog and value peace of mind, ATD is definitely the right choice!

We are delighted to have found ATD. They truly care about our dog as much as we do! Batman loves the staff and is always tired out when he comes home. I love how easy it is to drop off & pick up, as well as utilize the online reservation platform. The daycare sends photos so we know he is having a great time. Staff are very knowledgable on dog behaviour and socialization, which is great for a new puppy such as Batman!

Love this place and the owners are wonderful dog people
Your dogs are in good hands here

I would give them ten stars if I could! What a wonderful surprise to have found them! Not only did they treat my dog with lots of love, they made sure she felt safe and got extra attention when Katherine (the owner) noticed my Joy was anxious from being away from me! I REALLY appreciate all the attention and all the great energy I found in your establishment! Katherine, you are a ray of light! Thank you for everything! Please come to the US! ❤️

We had a great experience with the dog boarding service. Meli is an anxious dog, and they treated her with extreme care, patience, and respect. They did everything they could to make her feel comfortable and at home, especially since it was her first time boarding. We really appreciated the videos and updates throughout the day that showed us how she was doing and adapting. Thank you to all the workers who took such great care of Meli and made sure she felt safe and comfortable. We truly appreciate it and would highly recommend their service.
They are so kind and welcoming. I needed my little Yorkie groomed urgently, and they accommodated me quickly. Plus, my little girl looked gorgeous after her haircut and had exactly what I asked for.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Exceptional service!!! My baby Zack loves going to daycare, and we are truly delighted with the welcome and attention he receives. The team is caring, professional, and really takes good care of the dogs. You can tell they love their work and the animals. Thank you for everything! 🐶❤️

Can’t even put into words how amazing ATD clubhouse is!! Everyone here truly truly cares for each dog here. We have two dogs that have been coming here for almost a year now and they are absolutely thriving. We have them groomed/nails trimmed (and love the results)!

We also had one of them home-boarded for a long weekend. Felt really safe and assured leaving him with Solo and Catherine. Received plenty of updates and photos throughout 💕

Shoutout to Solo and Catherine who have gone out of their way to help us so many times ❤️

Should we be careful with these razor machines? They disconnected very often while cutting my dog's hair… When the woman cutting the hair had the correct position to use the razor, the machine wouldn't work because of the cable. It disconnected very often from the power outlet and also from the razor itself! It was a bad experience! We stayed there the whole time, over two hours, and my one-year-old dog was very stressed, especially since it was only the second time she'd had her hair cut!

When we adopted Bear, we knew apartment and city living would be a big adjustment for him. ATD has been an amazing addition to our lives because it provides regular contact with dogs in a safe and fun way.

He leaves ATD looking so fulfilled and sleepy. The staff is great at providing a report card at the end of his day with pictures and videos.

We've also taken advantage of their grooming services and were really pleased with how they deshedded his double coat. It would have taken us the whole summer to do what they did in a day.

But the best part of ATD is their pickup and drop off service. We don't own a car and Bear isn't quite ready for the metro yet so it's been invaluable to us. Thank you, ATD!

I use this daycare for my puppy Henri, a 4-month-old miniature dachshund, and I'm really happy with the service. It's a warm and welcoming place where he can socialize while being well looked after. The staff is very attentive and responsive to each dog's needs. I also love receiving photos and videos at the end of the day. It's a little extra that makes all the difference. I highly recommend it!
The team is knowledgeable and attentive to every dogs need. They helped me put a plan in place so that my pup can have a pleasant , anxiety-freedaycar experience. Amazing team.

I have 100% confidence in ATD Clubhouse to look after my energetic 5-month-old terrier, who is still learning good manners and canine communication, and therefore requires constant supervision. As a slightly anxious dog mom, I wholeheartedly recommend Clubhouse for the peace of mind the place and the team provide. Elfa is an exceptional caregiver: attentive, patient, and always responsive to my puppy's needs. The manager, Cassidy, is incredibly professional and does everything she can to ensure the dogs feel comfortable and have a positive experience. The daycare is very clean and safe, separating dogs according to their size and energy level, and is run by an experienced and truly passionate team. I come home to my dog ​​after work, happy, fully exercised, and ready for a relaxing evening. A huge thank you!

This place is amazing! Catherine and Solomon and Cassidy are wonderful! My babies are obsessed with this doggie daycare. The best part is not only do they get to run around all day but they get picked up and dropped off! The space is beautiful and so clean! You can tell that they love dogs so much and the relationship they have with my girls is unbeatable. I recommend this place to anyone that will listen to me lol
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad to have had the opportunity to care for your furry friend.

We can’t thank Catherine and the entire team enough for everything they did for us. We found ourselves in a very stressful situation and needed a last-minute boarding arrangement for our mini Aussiedoodle, Trevi. Catherine was an absolute lifesaver. She was incredibly accommodating, kind, and went above and beyond to help us when we needed it most.

Leaving your dog is never easy, especially on such short notice, but Catherine immediately put us at ease. We knew Trevi was in great hands from the moment we dropped her off. When we picked her up, she was happy, healthy, and clearly had been loved and well cared for.

The level of compassion, professionalism, and genuine care we experienced was exceptional. We are so grateful to Catherine and the entire team for making such a stressful situation so much easier. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a safe, trustworthy place for their dog. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of our sweet girl, Trevi! ❤️

We've been going there for a year now, about once a week. It's such a joy for both of us! The happiness on her little face when she arrives at the end of the day 😍 It's become a must for us.

The team is wonderful and the two founders are incredibly kind!

Incredible service! It was our first time using a dog sitter, and we were so happy with the service! They took care of our little Rocket as if she were their own. They sent us updates, photos, and videos every day, which was so reassuring to see how happy and fun she was! 10/10! Thank you again to the ATD team for everything 🥰 …

ATD is the best daycare in town! My dog is always so well taken care of, and the adorable photos they send at the end of the day are such a wonderful bonus. I always know my pup is happy and in great hands!
Impeccable service!

I entrusted my French bulldog to Catherine at ATD Clubhouse and received the best possible service 🔥

An incredible team who love the dogs they care for as if they were their own. My dog ​​came home happier than ever.

I highly recommend ATD to everyone; they are fantastic!

We were very happy with them the owner personally talked about our dog, and the dog was very happy and didn't want to leave, they send you regular updates and overall care about your dog, even do special requests, overall 10/10 I wish they would work on weekends tho 🙏 …
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a great experience with us.

All The Dog Clubhouse is amazing. ATD treats my pet like their own, offer truly personalized care, and really take the time to understand each dog’s personality, helping them interact smoothly with others. The team is friendly, reliable, and always great to work with. Their pick‑up and drop‑off service makes everything effortless, and I always have complete peace of mind knowing my dogs are in the best hands.
First time going with my dogs, service was quick. They cater to all types of dogs (even ones with attitude problems :P)

ATD Clubhouse is the warmest dog daycare in Montreal. My little Méo, who is naturally shy, spends wonderful days surrounded by several other dogs and the loving, attentive staff. As soon as we enter the daycare, we feel all the love these people have for animals, and that warms my heart. Thank you, ATD!

A.T.D. is the best Doggie Daycare and Groomer in Montreal..... My Dog Jagger and l used to love to go to A.T.D. until something bad happened and now we cannot go to A.T.D. anymore..... Catherine is an exquisite and magnificent Diamond Doll.... I know one day we:ll be friends again.... I just know we'll be..... I am The five time Author and Thug-Life Captain who made Montreal's East End globally famous.... David Dane Wallace.,.. aka..... Von"The Icon"...... Cassidy is a very special Princess who cares about all The Doggies there..... Maybe because l did something wrong before l can now do something right.... Catherine is so special that l would die for her without having to be asked twice.... Jagger and l give ATD 5 Stars.....

Excellent grooming service! From the warm welcome with a smile and coffee to the little touches for my dog, the customer experience was top-notch 👌 I'll definitely be back. I'll probably try the doggy daycare, but I'll definitely be there for my next pedicure! I highly recommend it 💯 …
Really great daycare, our dog is so happy to go there!
Friendly knowledgeable staff, clean building, my dog had a great day and is happy to be part of the ATD Clubhouse pack!
A place the whole family loves, including the dog! All the staff adore dogs; they play freely and have fun all day long, and they receive plenty of attention and love! Great grooming service too!
These guys are the absolute best! They’re so nice and sweet with the dogs and so easy to deal with. My pup Eli loves coming here.

Our pup Cooper absolutely loves daycare at ATD and the team always takes such good care of him ! The service here is great and everyone is so friendly, you can rest assured that your pets are being cared for like one of their own. The grooming service is also wonderful and very convenient.

The staff are friendly and the place is clean and cozy. When I visited for the first time grooming, I was not happy with the results, however, the owner tried to make it up and offered another session with their professional groomer! And the results were much better than the first time. I visited the third time for the grooming when my dog had enough fur around her face and Nancy did a great job with the grooming and delivered the expected results. I would say ATD Cloubhouse is very patient and helpful with picky customers like myself. I recommend this place for the dedication and commitment they make to deliver the best results.

We love ATD. Charlie has been taken care of on several occasions with great care and attention. They provide photos and videos for the pawrents as well. The facility is clean, and it’s clear they do the work out of love for animals. I would trust them with the dog any day. On the bonus side, he comes home happy and tired from all the play.
Great service. Easy to book an appointment and they always take excellent care of our dog. Highly recommend.

If you are looking for quality and think of your pets as family this is truly the place for you. I take my little Shiba (Copper) here whenever we are in town. The care and compassion of the staff and owner are unmatched. While it can be on the more expensive side of things it really is worth it to put him in the hands of trusted professionals who will treat your dog(s) with the love and respect they deserve. While Copper mostly goes for nail clippings and bath time all of the dogs there for daycare seem to be having the best of time and the ratio of humans to dogs is always great you know that they are truly in great, safe hands. If your dogs are your family and not simply a pet then this is the place for you.

Our sweet Ziggy absolutely loves his pals at the ATD Clubhouse! . Does he try to eat all of their treats? Yes. Does he try to steal all of their attention? Sure does.
We're so grateful for the upmost care that they show him. They have even gone out of their way to help us with weekend care when work & travel popped up.
Truly a fabulous, caring team. Thank you, ATD!

Glad i found this place, the personnel are friendly and professional. They managed to cut my 100lbs german shepard's nails in a few minutes, much faster than the last grooming store i used. The store is beautifully decorated and they have a waiting area for furparents. Will definitely be back.

Great place, great ambiance, great service, great price, great location!

Good job.

Daniel Tadros

Cassydy and her team are truly attentive and concerned about the well-being of our dogs. Adrian is always delighted to see them again. Furthermore, his grooming was exactly what I expected...Well done to all!

Ah, Nancy. The best. My dogs love her; she always cuts them exactly how I want them and trims my anxious Chihuahuas' nails without any trouble. Other places leave the nails too long out of fear... I don't know. But Nancy is a true professional; I go everywhere with her. The place is wonderful. Pleasant. No pressure. Magnificent owner. Just wow ❤️

Loved the experience! I left my dog here and it was honestly one of the best decisions I’ve made. From the moment we arrived, the staff were warm, welcoming, and made both me and my dog feel completely at ease.

He had so much fun and came back happy, relaxed, and clearly well cared for. I loved how attentive everyone was and how comfortable the environment felt—it really gave me peace of mind knowing he was in good hands. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals, not just as clients but as little personalities they get to know.

The whole experience was smooth, well-organized, and stress-free. My dog absolutely loved it, and I could see how much he enjoyed his time there. I’m so glad I chose this place and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for a safe, caring, and fun environment for their dog!
I really loved my experience here. The space is beautiful, and the staff are attentive, caring, and thoughtful.

Stop right where you are while I tell you about how wonderful ATD Clubhouse is! :)  I cannot say enough good things about this very special doggy daycare, and the best one I have ever come across at that. From the first contact with their manager, Cassidy, before Minnie's evaluation day, I felt at ease. Being in Montréal with a pitbull is in itself a bit daunting, so I was unsure if I'd be able to find a place that would accept her. ATD Clubhouse is truly one of a kind. They are so knowledgeable, inclusive, and open to understanding all dogs and their behaviors or quirks. Catherine and Saloman are incredible humans who have devoted their lives to these dogs, and you can tell how much they genuinely care. To top it off, they are so kind welcoming, and the staff is equally as wonderful. I feel so comfortable leaving Minnie here during the day and trust she will come home happy, healthy, and tired. I cannot recommend ATD Clubhouse enough, and am so grateful to have found this close-knit dog family. Merci à vous!!!

Such amazing service. The whole team was so sweet with my little boy Brody!! He smells amazing & was so happy, playing with the other dogs when I went back to pick him up. You can really tell the care they give to the animals and I highly recommend. Will be going back forsure

I’ve been bringing my dogs to ATD for over two years, and it has been an incredible addition to the neighborhood. The location is perfect—conveniently close to the metro and grocery stores—but it’s the staff that truly sets them apart. They are professional, loving, and incredibly accommodating. My dog, Epi, can be a bit shy, but their regular updates throughout the day always put me at ease. Plus, his grooming is consistently flawless—a huge thank you to Nancy!
We sent our puppy, Teddy, for the first time to be groomed at ATD and were so impressed with the service and his haircut! He looks better than ever and we couldn’t be more grateful ☺️

Honestly such an amazing place! Everything is so clean and you can tell the staff truly cares about the dogs. You receive updates during the day which is always amazing, the pics and videos make my day. This place is a gem I would definitely recommend!!
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad to have had the opportunity to serve you. 🐾. …
The staff are so kind and the service is always impeccable!!

Marvelous place! All the staff is loving, very respectful of our doggos. The place is impeccable. It was Roma's first time there, she was quite hyper!! The wonderful woman who gave her a bath and trimmed her nails was very respectful of my girl's fears and limits... When I came to get her, I could see Roma really liked her...

We had such a wonderful experience at ATD Clubhouse! My princess Chloe had an amazing time there. We’re currently traveling out of the country with our dog, and it gave us so much peace of mind to find a place where she was so well cared for while we explored the city.

The staff is incredibly friendly, and you can truly tell they love what they do. All the dogs looked so happy and comfortable with them. Chloe had the best time and even made some new furry friends!

I would absolutely recommend ATD Clubhouse to anyone traveling to Montreal with their dog and looking to enjoy the city without worrying about their pet. It’s also a fantastic option for locals in need of a trustworthy and fun doggy daycare.
I can’t recommend this grooming salon enough! Everyone there is incredibly kind and welcoming. You can really feel that they provide a personalized service and genuinely care about each dog.
Clean, efficient and very nice staff 🧡 …
Nancy did a great job grooming my cocker spaniel, gently removing her knots and using scissors for most of the cut, as requested. Would recommend!

My tiny chihuahua is very anxious in general and I was so nervous to leave her for the first time here. The lady was so kind and patient with her, my dog came back without a scratch and was the calmest she has ever been. Amazing customer service, will be coming back!!
I used their service for the first time and I couldn't be happier.... my little dog was perfect even prettier than usual haha
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our community. 🐾. …

The ATD team is wonderful! You feel welcome as soon as you walk through the door. Big smiles, passionate and dedicated people. My dog ​​is 5 months old, and thanks to ATD, she's now super sociable. She gets so excited in the car on the way to daycare. When she arrives, she doesn't even hesitate to come inside and doesn't even look at me when I leave. I've also used their grooming services, and the experience was just as good as ATD's services. I'm so happy to be able to count on the ATD family to take care of my little girl while I'm at work! We love you so much ❤️❤️

Always perfect, by far the Best!
Really recommend
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon. 🐾. …
Tessa always gets pampered at ATD and is quite addicted to going there. Always a pleasure!

Catherine and Cassidy have been so helpful and accommodating with me and my 9 month old French Bulldog puppy. We’ve dropped our puppy off for a few daycare sessions and she has come back happy and exhausted, which has been amazing. They also sent ample photos and videos and you can see they do a great job paying close attention to their entire pack in house that day.

I’ve also had them help coordinate boarding for our dog while we’ve been away on vacation recently and cannot say enough great things about that whole process and who they placed our dog with.

I highly recommend looking into sending your dog here to tire them out, and know they will be in great hands.

ATD Clubhouse is hands down one of the best doggy daycares and groomers we have ever encountered.

Our Bernese Mountain Dog puppy stayed at ATD Clubhouse in Montreal for a full week while we were visiting the city, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

From the very beginning, the owners, Catherine and Solomon, went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly and that our pup felt completely at home.

They were incredibly flexible with pick-up and drop-off times, which meant so much to us and allowed us to truly relax and enjoy our trip to Montreal. That level of care and understanding is rare—and deeply appreciated.

Beyond their professionalism, Katherine and Solomon are simply kind, loving, and genuinely amazing people. You can feel how much they care about the dogs in their charge. The daycare itself is absolutely stunning, and we felt immediately at ease leaving our puppy there.

Each day, he came back to us so happy and perfectly exhausted, clearly having had the best time. It was clear that his days were thoughtfully structured, his needs were met, and he had wonderful social time with the other dogs in a safe and enriching environment.

If ATD Clubhouse ever comes to the UK, we would be there in a heartbeat. We cannot recommend them highly enough.

A truly heartfelt thank you to Catherine, Solomon, and the entire ATD team for taking such wonderful care of our boy.

-

ATD Clubhouse is without a doubt one of the best dog daycares we have ever experienced in Montreal.

Our Bernese Mountain Dog puppy stayed at ATD Clubhouse in Montreal for a full week during our visit to the city, and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. From the very beginning, the owners, Catherine and Solomon, went above and beyond to ensure everything ran smoothly and that our puppy felt right at home.

They were incredibly flexible with drop-off and pick-up times, which meant a lot to us and allowed us to truly enjoy our stay in Montreal. This level of attention and understanding is rare and so appreciated.

Beyond their high level of professionalism, Katherine and Solomon are, above all, kind, caring, and deeply compassionate people. You can immediately feel how much they love dogs and take their role to heart. The daycare itself is beautiful, and we felt completely at ease from the very first moment. Every day, our puppy came home happy and pleasantly tired, clear proof that he had had a wonderful time. It was evident that his days were well-structured, tailored to his needs, and full of positive interactions with other dogs.

If ATD Clubhouse ever comes to the UK, we will be there without hesitation. A huge thank you from the bottom of our hearts to Katherine, Solomon, and the entire ATD team for taking such great care of our companion. We recommend this dog daycare in Montreal without hesitation.
Hi Vimal! Thank you so much for your five star rating and for bringing Bruie to ATD Clubhouse for her grooming. We miss her already.

When they first opened I asked if they also do cats and since then Nancy has been my trusted groomer. She's quick and makes it very easy, even with my scaredy cat.
The set up they have for their doggie boarders looks great, the whole place has a lovely atmosphere, and the team is super engaging, friendly, and lovely all around!
Can highly recommend them if you're in the area!
The service is impeccable and the team is amazing. My dog loves going there, I highly recommend it! :)
The salon is beautiful and clean! They take great care of the dogs! And they're very attentive to their clients! 🙏🏼 …
Fantastic experience! I entrusted my 4-month-old toy poodle puppy to Nancy, and he came back looking gorgeous! It's 100% worth the price! I highly recommend her.

Cookie loves going to daycare; when we approach, she gets so excited, her little tail wagging with joy.

Thank you to the whole team for your care and especially for your love ❤️ for our little ones.
Perfect 🤩 …

A calming, clean, and welcoming place for us and our beloved dogs! The staff is charming and professional. I'm extremely satisfied with the grooming my Corgi, Chopin, received from the lovely Elsa. I highly recommend this dog grooming center.
